title: Tomography of quantum states with bounded extent
summary: We give a general framework for tomography of states that have bounded-extent with respect to a structured class of states. Let $\textsf{C}$ be a family of $n$-qubit states such that: $(i)$ $\textsf{C}$ is succinctly representable and $(ii)$ there is a weak agnostic learner of $\textsf{C}$. We give a tomography protocol for an unknown state $|ψ\rangle$ that is promised to admit a decomposition of the form $|ψ\rangle = \sum_i c_i |φ_i\rangle$, where $|φ_i\rangle \in \textsf{C}$ with bounded $\ell_1$-norm of the coefficients (which we call extent).
